data.content:
Root cause: `@pantoken/web-components@0.6.6` was bumped correctly and its Git tag exists. npm had already staged/published that version, but the custom release script only checked GitHub releases, so CI retried npm publishing and received `409 Cannot publish over previously staged version`.

I updated [publish-npm.ts](scripts/release/publish-npm.ts#L174) to re-check npm after a failed publish and treat an exact version already present as successful. Added regression coverage in [publish-npm.main.test.ts](scripts/release/publish-npm.main.test.ts#L181).

Validation: focused release tests pass, `19/19`. The failed workflow can now be manually re-run; npm reports `@pantoken/web-components@0.6.6` as `latest`.
